title: Possible flood-related radar change - San Juan River, Pagosa Springs, CO
method: HH backscatter, 5x5 speckle filter, overall -0.57 dB offset removed, threshold 3 dB
plain_summary: Radar shows more change along the San Juan River than away from it: about 8 times more flagged pixels within 200 m of the river, mostly brighter. This fits the reported October flood, but it is flagged change, not confirmed flooding.
limitations: Before and after use different processing versions (provisional vs validated) - part of any change may come from processing
Overall median change is about -0.6 dB across the whole box, likely not flood-related
After image is ~3 days after the Oct 23 crest, so the flood may have been receding
About 1,695 pixels (0.17%) have fewer than 1 look and are noisier (same pixels on both dates)
Mountain valley terrain - steep slopes can cause radar artifacts
Reference evidence so far is news reports and emergency declarations, not an official flood-extent map
No official flood-extent map was available to check against, so results are exploratory.
